Eastland Community Updates: August 2026

See below for updates on what's going on in our community!

Questions about anything shared? Contact Noelle Britt at nhbritt@columbus.gov or 614-645-5449.

Want to stay up to date on future Eastland events and news? Visit eastlandforeveryone.com for up to date information about community happenings!

Events
Resources
News

Stay engaged, stay involved, and let’s build this bright future for Eastland together.

COMMUNITY EVENTS

Rise Up CBUS!

We're taking community pride to a whole new level! Learn about resources from city and community partners. Enjoy free food and music, and connect with your neighbors. Admission is free. Rise Up CBUS! supports every Columbus resident to equitably prosper and grow.

Join us on the following dates from 4:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m., unless otherwise noted.

Thursday, Aug. 6, 2026 | Driving Park: 1100 Rhoads Ave., 43206

Thursday, Aug. 27, 2026 | Colerain Elementary: 499 E. Weisheimer Road, 43214

Thursday, Sept. 10, 2026 | First Church of God: 3480 Refugee Road, 43232

Learn More

Our Voice, Our Choice Budget

The City of Columbus is proud to launch its first ever Participatory Budgeting process. Our Voice, Our Choice Budget is a process that gives community members direct access to propose ideas for how to spend $9 million of the City's capital budget.

Upcoming Idea Collection events are a great opportunity to learn more about Participatory Budgeting, ask questions and share your ideas in person.

Can't make it to an event? You can still participate by submitting your ideas online at the link below.

Upcoming Idea Collection Events

  • Wednesdays July 29- Aug 28, 2026 | 5:00–6:30 p.m. | 5825 Chantry Drive, Columbus, OH (District 9 — Columbus Literary Council)
  • Thur, Aug 6, 2026 | 6:30–8:00 p.m. | 1393 E. Broad St. Columbus, OH (District 5 — See Brilliance)
  • Fri, Aug 7, 2026 | 12:00-1:30 p.m. | 5825 Chantry Drive, Columbus, OH (District 9 — Columbus Literary Council)
  • Fri, Aug 7, 2026 | 5:00-6:30 p.m. | 5825 Chantry Drive, Columbus, OH (District 9 — Columbus Literary Council)
  • Tue, Aug 11, 2026 | 6:00–8:00 p.m. | Warner Woods Pavilion (Districts 1, 4 & 5 — Northland Community Council Picnic)
  • Sat, Aug 15, 2026 | 12:00-3:00 p.m. | 5825 Chantry Drive, Columbus, OH (District 9 — Columbus Literary Council)
  • Sun, Aug 16, 2026 | 12:00-3:00 p.m. | 5825 Chantry Drive, Columbus, OH (District 9 — Columbus Literary Council)
Learn More

PlayStreets

PlayStreets events are free block parties held every summer in the Linden and South Side communities. Each event features family-friendly activities, food trucks, music, inflatables, petting zoos and more.

Families and children are encouraged to get outside and join the fun with your neighbors at a location near you.

All events are from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.

Linden Fresh Market (1464 Cleveland Ave.): August 8

Maize Manor United Methodist Church (3901 Maize Rd.): August 22

The Residences at Career Gateway (755 E. Whittier St.): August 1

The Reeb Avenue Center (280 Reeb Ave.): August 15

Learn More

Back-to-School Vaccine Clinics

Saturday, August 1 | 12 – 4 PM @ Columbus Public Health: 240 Parsons Ave.

Monday, August 3 | 1– 4 PM @ Linden Community Center: 1350 Briarwood Ave.

Wednesday, August 5 | 12 – 6 PM @ Watkins Elementary: 1520 Watkins Rd.

Wednesday, August 12 | 12 - 6 PM @ Woodward Park Middle (5151 Karl Rd.)

Visit one of Columbus Public Health's Back-to-School Vaccine Clinics to ensure your kids are up to date on their vaccines ahead of the school year!

The clinic on August 1 will also feature crib sign-ups, car seat sign-ups, WIC support, STI & pregnancy tests, well-women exams, and birth control resources.

Learn More

National Night Out

Tuesday, August 4, 2026 | Citywide

National Night Out is a fun, annual, community-building campaign that promotes partnership between first responders and the community, and builds neighborhood camaraderie. Click the link below and use the map to find an event near you!

Learn More

Saturday, August 8, 2026
7:00 AM - 12:00 PM

Long Street Business Association:
823 1/2 E Long Street, Columbus, Ohio, 43203

Black Men's Wellness Day isn’t just an event – it's a movement. It's about understanding the health disparities that exist, taking actionable steps towards better health, and celebrating the strength and resilience of our community.

Learn More

Saturday, August 8, 2026
10:00 AM - 11:00 AM

Wolfe Park Trail:
105 Park Drive, Columbus, OH, 43209

Queens in Motion is a monthly walking group centered on connection, wellness, and moving at our own pace. Join us for a 1.8-mile walk designed for all exercise levels—whether you’re strolling or striding, no Queen is left behind. Come as you are and move with the Village.

Register Here

10:00 AM - 1:00 PM

546 Jack Gibbs Boulevard, Columbus, Ohio, 43215

Come to one of the largest back-to-school events in the City of Columbus! FREE backpacks, books, and school supplies. Over 100 CCS departments and community partners will be available to assist with back to school resources including health screenings, home safety, after school programs and social service information.

2:00 PM - 6:00 PM

Enjoy an afternoon of music, food, free haircuts, family-friendly activities, and connections to valuable community resources.

Wednesday, August 19, 2026
12:00 PM - 2:00 PM

Columbus Metropolitan Library Barnett Branch: 3434 East Livingston Avenue, Columbus, OH, 43227

Join us to connect with fellow business owners and entrepreneurs, share your successes, discuss the challenges facing your business, and help shape the future of economic growth in the Eastland community! Registration required.

Register Here

Wednesday, August 19, 2026
5:00 PM - 6:30 PM

Crittenton Community Center: 3840 Kimberly Pkwy N, Columbus, OH 43232

Join us for our first ever Back-to-School Bash - an outdoor concert and fun evening for the whole family to kick off the school year! Enjoy live music from the Conspiracy Band, stock up on free school supplies, learn about community resources, and more!

Register Here

Directions for Youth & Families: Senior Programming
Last Friday of the Month

Friday, August 28, 2026
10:00 AM - 12:00 PM

Crittenton Community Center: 3840 Kimberly Pkwy N, Columbus, OH 43232

Join us for senior programming and activities that provide a space for Eastland seniors to learn about and access needed services, build connections with other seniors, foster intergenerational connections, and combat the senior loneliness epidemic.

Stay engaged with your local Area Commission! Check out the events calendar for upcoming meetings. Eastland is served by the following area commissions:

Far East Area Commission

Mideast Area Commission

Greater South East Area Commission

COMMUNITY RESOURCES

Lead Safe Columbus

Own a home built before 1978 and worry about the potential dangers of lead? You could qualify for grant funds from the City of Columbus to help eliminate the sources of lead poisoning in your home, as well as address healthy homes hazards and radon mitigation.

You can learn more about qualifying as a homeowner or landlord and apply at our website using the link below.

Learn More

Mayor Ginther Expands Clean and Safe Corridors Initiative

Mayor Andrew J. Ginther kicked off the 2026 Clean and Safe Corridors Initiative, which will focus on Long Street in the King-Lincoln District, Refugee Road on the Southeast side and State Route 161 (Dublin-Granville Road) in Northland.

Street repair and cleanup projects began today in King Lincoln, with work scheduled to begin in the Refugee Road area in May and along 161-Dublin Granville Road in July. Each corridor will also benefit from a $50,000 microgrant, administered by trusted community partners:

  • Columbus Urban League will partner with the city on Long Street in the King-Lincoln Bronzeville district with a focus on small business grants and homeownership.
  • Elevate Northland will partner with the city in its work on State Route 161 in Northland, focusing on traffic improvement, including sidewalks and signage.
  • City of Refuge and the Good Life Foundation will partner with the city in its work on Refugee Road in the Southeast side, with a focus on education and entrepreneurship.
